content.what_it_is: MATLAB movie postprocessor for a rip/foam case. It loads depth solely to size a 1 m by 2 m mesh and opens an MPEG-4 writer (L3-L18). For k=3..32 it maps frames to time, instantaneous output index, and a 50 s averaged-velocity index (L26-L42), loads eta/FoamEta/u/v, then plots elevation, curl vorticity, and log foam thickness with velocity arrows (L48-L101). It captures each figure to video, closes the movie, and saves the final frame as eta_vor_foam.jpg (L103-L115).
unresolved: Mask loading and all mask applications are commented out at L34,L36-L37,L44-L46. Eta, FoamEta, mean velocity, curl, and quiver therefore include any dry-cell/sentinel values even though copied masking code is present but ineffective.

`log(FoamEta)` at L85 has no positivity guard: zero foam thickness maps to -Inf and negative values produce complex results, while caxis is finite [-10,10] at L90. The file does not state a floor or missing-value convention.

Instantaneous files use num=k-1 at L29 while averaged velocity uses floor(time/50) at L30 with time=(k-1)*30 at L28. These two cadence assumptions are hard-coded and no timestamps are compared, so the overlaid quivers can be temporally mispaired if either output cadence differs.
No shape checks relate dep, eta, FoamEta, u, and v. `w_ang` is unused, and the absolute user-specific fdir at L3 is unchecked.
